description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: An elongated low caddy has three open channels and a transverse carrying handle. Side: The handle arches over the compartments without touching their floors. Rear: The rear has the same full-height wall and visible handle bindings. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: An elongated low caddy has three open channels and a transverse carrying handle. Side: The handle arches over the compartments without touching their floors. Rear: The rear has the same full-height wall and visible handle bindings. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.. Style Royal: formal symmetry and graceful bound borders without emblems. Relative size compact within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: open square lattice made from wider flat strips. Finish: natural matte honey-tan fibers. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, level with product center. No three-quarter or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
